# API reference

<!-- Generated by tools/SchoMans.DocGen from the code. Do not edit by hand; change the code and run `dotnet run --project tools/SchoMans.DocGen`. -->

181 operations, read from the endpoints the API registers. Every route is under the base address of the API; list endpoints take `page` and `pageSize` (at most 100) and return `PagedResult<T>`. Errors are ProblemDetails.
The interactive reference (Scalar) is at `/scalar` in the Development and Demo environments. **Auth** is the first layer of the two-layer authorization: the role policy of the endpoint; the ownership check in the Application layer comes on top of it.
